_comment: Operational application settings that used to live here are now managed in the Configuration Management module (DB tables TmX_Configuration_*) and read via the DB->IConfiguration bridge (DbConfigurationProvider). Edit them at /admin/configuration, NOT in this file. What REMAINS here on purpose: SECRETS held in the secret store (ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection, Jwt:Key, Workflow:LicenseKey), BOOTSTRAP/STRUCTURAL keys read at startup before/independent of the DB layer (Api:RoutePrefix, Jwt:Issuer/Audience, Auth path allow-lists, Workflow:RuntimeId, AllowedHosts), the logging pipeline config (Integration:Diagnostics — not yet bridged), non-secret live integration config still consumed directly (Integration:Onboarding non-secret fields, Integration:Brains), and the two service-identity ids not yet migrated (PeriodicReview:ReviewerUserId, CustomerInsightSnapshot:WriterUserId). NOTE: the FCCM integration SECRETS moved OUT of this file into the Configuration module as ENCRYPTED Secret values (Data Protection at rest, decrypted at use): Integration.Onboarding.Password and Integration.FccmOracleConnection; Integration.Onboarding.Username moved as a String. Integration:FccmCallbackSharedSecret stays here for now (currently blank/unenforced). The DB store's per-setting Default_Value is the fallback for migrated keys (not this file).

Api.//RoutePrefix: Leading route segment for all controllers. Default 'api' -> /api/v1/.... Under an IIS app already named 'api', disable it so the URL stays /api/v1/... not /api/api/v1/.... In appsettings use "" (empty). For an env var / web.config use Api__RoutePrefix=none (Windows cannot hold an EMPTY env var). Accepted disable sentinels: "", none, (none), -.

Jwt.//_note: Secrets/structural only. AccessTokenDefaultMinutes / RefreshTokenFactor / RoleTtlMinutes are now DB-managed (Configuration Management > Security).

Auth.//_note: Path allow-lists + bootstrap admin roles are structural/security-critical and stay here. RestrictConcurrentLogin / RequireDeviceIdHeader / DeviceIdHeaderName are now DB-managed (Configuration Management > Security).

Integration.//_note: CustomerMasterBaseUrl, FccmOnboardingUrl, FccmOracleSchema, PollingInterval, CaseIdTimeout, HttpTimeout, TradeCaseDefaults.*, and FccmActionCodeStatusMap are now DB-managed (Configuration Management > FCCM/Integration). The FCCM onboarding credentials (Onboarding.Username/Password) AND the Oracle connection (FccmOracleConnection) are also managed there now — the two secrets stored ENCRYPTED. What remains here: the FCCM callback shared secret (blank/unenforced), the non-secret Onboarding + Brains integration config, and the logging (Diagnostics) pipeline config.

Onboarding._comment: KYC -> FCCM onboarding submission (InitiateOnboardingService/OB/Initiate). Auth is HTTP Basic. The Username + Password have been MOVED to the Configuration module (Configuration > FCCM/Integration): Integration.Onboarding.Username (String, bridged) and Integration.Onboarding.Password (Secret, stored ENCRYPTED, read decrypted at use via ISecretConfigReader). Set/rotate them from the UI. The payload SHAPE and ALL its constants (CustomerType, Jurisdiction, BusinessDomain, etc.) are defined entirely in the mapping-profile file selected by MappingProfile (Mappings/onboarding/onboarding.{profile}.mapping.json) and are intentionally NOT duplicated here.
Onboarding._ApplicationIdFormat: Pattern for the FCCM applicationId; {0} = customer code. 'CIF-{0}' -> 'CIF-<code>'. Use '{0}' to send the bare code.
Onboarding._MappingProfile_note: v2 = the newer InitiateOnboarding contract this environment uses. Its onboarding.v2.mapping.json root is exactly { requestUserId, applicationId, SyncAPIFlag, OnboardingCustomer } to match the verified working request. The OFSAA envelope fields (infodom / RequestID / PMFProcess / locale) were REMOVED from the v2 profile on 2026-07-06 because the live endpoint returns HTTP 400 ('extra property ... not according to the schema definition') when they are present at root. v1 is the legacy flat KYCRequestModel shape kept for backward-compat. Keep this on v2 for this environment.

Diagnostics._comment: Module-wise diagnostic logging — the new-stack equivalent of the legacy custom-DLL + NLog dedicated log files. 'Files' defines one dedicated daily-rolling file per area; each file's 'Level' controls how much it captures and 'Enabled' turns it on/off. Level is a Serilog level: 'Error'/'Fatal' = errors only, 'Warning' = warnings+errors, 'Information' = normal (API request/response + lifecycle), 'Debug'/'Verbose' = full detail (onboarding payloads, FCCM responses, every Oracle FCC_OB_RA poll, risk-param derivation). FILES: 'Application.UserManagement' = Auth/Users/Roles API calls; 'Application.Trade' = all other API calls (Transaction/KYC/Flags/Workflow/Reports/...) plus FCCM onboarding detail; 'BackgroundService' = hosted services (FccmCaseIdPoller + LogArchiver). Each Application.* file logs end-to-end API request+response bodies (sensitive endpoints redacted) and full exception inner-chains. RetentionDays: rolled files older than this are zipped by LogArchiverService into backlogs_<from>-<to>.zip (originals deleted); ArchiveScanIntervalHours controls how often it checks. LogDirectory is relative to the API content root unless absolute. NOTE: the /admin/configuration 'Diagnostics/Logging' rows are Phase-2 (not yet bridged) — this section is still authoritative for logging.
Diagnostics._LogDirectory_note: Absolute path used here (dev). If left RELATIVE (e.g. "Logs") it resolves against the app content root = the published/deployed folder: published under IIS at C:\inetpub\wwwroot\TradeCompliance\ -> logs at C:\inetpub\wwwroot\TradeCompliance\Logs\. RECOMMENDED for production: an ABSOLUTE path OUTSIDE the web-served folder (e.g. C:\ProgramData\ICBC\TradeCompliance\Logs or D:\Logs\TradeCompliance) so logs are not web-accessible and survive redeploys; grant the app-pool identity write access. Override per-environment via appsettings.Production.json.
Diagnostics._Verbose_note: DEEP TRACING SWITCH is the per-module file Level below (Files:*:Level). Default 'Information' = milestone trail only: actor, operation, [STEP]s, stored-proc NAME + key params, FCCM URL + HTTP status, outcome, timing, failures. Set a module's Level to 'Debug' (e.g. Application.Trade) to additionally capture the high-volume [DETAIL] lines — full SP parameter values, onboarding request payload + response body, and full API request/response bodies. Restart to apply. Keep 'Information' in production; flip to 'Debug' only while chasing an issue. The Authorization header (FCCM Basic auth) is never logged at any level.

Integration.//FccmOracleConnection: MOVED to the Configuration module as an ENCRYPTED Secret (Integration.FccmOracleConnection). Set/rotate it at Configuration > FCCM/Integration; it is stored encrypted and read decrypted at use (FccmOracleReader + Test-connection probe). Left blank here so nothing plaintext remains; the config value is the source of truth.

Brains._comment: Third-party KYC screening provider (QueryKycInfoServlet). ALWAYS live — the in-process sandbox mode was removed (screening is gated on/off by Configuration Management > Onboarding.RequireExternalVerification). BaseUrl points at the real provider in Production, or the standalone BRAINS-compatible test provider in kyc-mock-provider/ (default http://localhost:9099) for dev/UAT.

PeriodicReview.//_note: Enabled / ScanInterval / BatchSize / LeadTimeDays / DefaultFrequency / Frequencies are now DB-managed (Configuration Management > Periodic Review). Only the reviewer service identity remains here (not yet migrated).

CustomerInsightSnapshot.//_note: Enabled / CheckInterval are now DB-managed (Configuration Management > Customer Insight). Only the writer service identity remains here (not yet migrated).

Email._comment: SECRET-ONLY. All operational email settings (Enabled, DeliveryMode, PickupDirectory, Host, Port, Username, UseSsl, From, MinSeverity) are now managed in the Configuration Management module (/admin/configuration -> Email / SMTP) and supplied via the DB->IConfiguration bridge. ONLY the SMTP password remains here as a file secret (the bridge excludes Is_Sensitive keys). Leave Password blank for PickupDirectory mode; fill it when using a real SMTP provider (e.g. Brevo/Mailtrap). Note: until the 2026_07_046 migration is run, EmailOptions falls back to its C# defaults for the moved keys (Enabled defaults to false), so the migration must run for email to be ON.

Workflow.//_note: InboxMaxPageSize is now DB-managed (Configuration Management > Workflow). LicenseKey (secret) + RuntimeId (structural) remain.
